plugins.description: Live recruitment analytics through the vetted metrics layer, plus 56 commands: reporting (/funnel /billing /chase /week), pipeline actions (/move /assign /pitch), records (/newcandidate /newjob /delete), and writing (/advert /boolean /email). Every write previews first and applies only on explicit confirmation. Bundles the Octagon connector.
